note: El Salvador: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 180 days (Bolivia 90), with proof of funds and onward documents; everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen, Canadian or US visas may enter: not modelled). Taiwan's exemption ended on 12 December 2018. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
